message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover with a cream background and red borders. At the top, the red title "TEMPO" is partially obscured by a hand in a light-colored sleeve holding an orange vest by its collar. The vest has three horizontal black stripes and contains the large black text "DALAM WASWAS SETRUM SOFYAN." 

Below this, white text describes a legal investigation. Another hand reaches from the left, touching the vest's hem. Directly beneath the vest, a caricature of a man’s head with a mustache and wide ears looks upward. He wears a white collared shirt.

Legible text at the top reads: "PEMILU: KLAIM CURANG DUA KANDIDAT" and "WAWANCARA JOKOWI: TUGAS PEMIMPIN BUKAN MEMANASKAN SUASANA." In the lower right, there is a date "29 APRIL- 5 MEI 2019," a price "RP 45.000," website "WWW.TEMPO.CO," and a barcode with numbers including "9 770126 427302." The slogan "ENAK DIPANDANG DAN PERLU" is partially visible behind the vest.
